title: Parts library entry (source.json)
description: One part in cad/library/<source>/<part>/: where it came from, under what licence, and the sha256 of each file as downloaded. vt350#268; cad/library/README.md explains each field. platform/library/check_library.py validates it (stdlib only, so it reads only: type, required, properties, additionalProperties, items, minItems, minLength, pattern, enum).

title.description: The part's name as its source page gives it.

author.description: The person or company to credit.

handle.description: The author's user name on the source site, if any (e.g. @EduardMandac_3771478).

source_url.description: The page the file was downloaded from.

licence.description: An SPDX licence id, or a LicenseRef-* defined in cad/credits.json.

licence_source.description: Where and when the licence was read (e.g. 'owner's screenshot of the Printables page, 2026-11-20').

downloaded.description: The date the files were downloaded (YYYY-MM-DD).

upstream_version.description: The upstream version, commit, or 'updated' date shown on the page.

redistributable.description: Whether the licence lets this repo share the files. false: no file may be committed; the entry keeps the URL, licence and sha256 so anyone can fetch and verify it.

committed.description: Default: the same as redistributable. false on a redistributable part keeps it a no-file entry anyway (e.g. too large for now); its files must then be absent too.

credit.description: The project key in cad/credits.json that credits this part, when CREDITS.md lists it.

archive.description: The download the files came out of, when it was an archive.

files.description: Every file of the part, as downloaded. When committed (by default: when redistributable) each one is in the entry's folder and must match its sha256; otherwise none may be.

path.description: The file name in the entry's folder (no sub-folders, no spaces wanted).

sha256.description: sha256 of the file as downloaded (committed files are never edited).

upstream_name.description: The file's name upstream (or in the archive), when it was renamed.

size.description: Size in bytes, for no-file entries.

notes.description: Anything a rebuilder needs: 'owner confirmed matches the real part', what the remix changed, why this part.
